desc:
In the somewhat regional town of Girralong, you are a signaller, or maybe a car driver, or maybe just a bystander.
Whatever you chose to be, you have control over what kind of chaos and destruction emerges in the town.

Drive cars in front of trains and watch them get smashed to pieces and explode, operate switches to cause a head-on train collision at over 100 km/hr, or have a demolition derby with your mates.



Created by matthewleg0 with help from X3R0ty.
